section.catchline: Disposition of certain taxes collected on Ute Indian land.
section.subsection: Except as provided in Subsection (2), there shall be deposited into the Uintah Basin Revitalization Fund created in Section 63N-24-602:for taxes imposed under this part, 33% of the taxes collected on oil, gas, or other hydrocarbon substances produced from a well:for which production began on or before June 30, 1995; andattributable to interests:held in trust by the United States for the Tribe and the Tribe's members; oron lands identified in Pub. L. No. 440, 62 Stat. 72 (1948);for taxes imposed under this part, 80% of taxes collected on oil, gas, or other hydrocarbon substances produced from a well:for which production began on or after July 1, 1995; andattributable to interests:held in trust by the United States for the Tribe and the Tribe's members; oron lands identified in Pub. L. No. 440, 62 Stat. 72 (1948); andfor taxes imposed under this part, 80% of taxes collected on oil, gas, or other hydrocarbon substances produced from a well:for which production began on or after January 1, 2001; andattributable to interests on lands conveyed to the tribe under the Ute-Moab Land Restoration Act, Pub. L. No. 106-398, Sec. 3303.

subsection.subsection: The maximum amount deposited in the Uintah Basin Revitalization Fund may not exceed:$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2005-06;$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2006-07;$6,000,000 in fiscal years 2007-08 and 2008-09; andfor fiscal years beginning with fiscal year 2009-10, the amount determined by the commission as described in Subsection (2)(b).

The commission shall increase or decrease the dollar amount described in Subsection (2)(a)(iii) by a percentage equal to the percentage difference between the consumer price index for the preceding calendar year and the consumer price index for calendar year 2008; and
after making an increase or decrease under Subsection (2)(b)(i), round the dollar amount to the nearest whole dollar.
For purposes of this Subsection (2), "consumer price index" is as described in Section 1(f)(4), Internal Revenue Code, and defined in Section (1)(f)(5), Internal Revenue Code.
Any amounts in excess of the maximum described in Subsection (2)(a) shall be credited as provided in Sections 51-9-305, 51-9-306, 51-9-1202, and 59-5-115.
